title: OpenAI Operator UNLEASHED: Stress Testing AI Agents in the Wild (Hands On Testing)

comments.author: @BruceWayne15325
comments.text:
People are focusing on the wrong things with Operator, so I don't think the public is getting an idea of just how mind blowing this is. The average person isn't going to spend $200/month to have AI browse the web for them or shop.
What they will pay that kind of money for (and it's a steal at that price) is things like:
1. Automated web designer that can do SEO work as well 
2. Automated Quality Assurance engineer for web-based products
3. Automated code reviewer for pull requests
4. Automated JIRA ticket research and maintenance for project managers
5. Automated forum manager
6. Automated customer support representative
Now you start to get the idea of just how huge this can be, and I just scratched the surface off the top of my head.
